Problem Statement:
You are given with an array. Your task is to print the left rotated array after k opearations.
Time:O(n)
Extra Space: O(1)
Input Description:
First line contains two number ‘n’ and ‘k’.Next line contains n space separated numbers. 
Output Description:
Print the array as mentioned. 
Sample Input:
7 3
1 2 3 4 5 6 7 
Sample Output:
4 5 6 7 1 2 3 
Explanation:
1 st time 2 3 4 5 6 7 1
2nd time 3 4 5 6 7 1 2
3rd time 4 5 6 7 1 2 3
